content.title: Inheritance and Defaults
content.hook: Some CSS properties can be inherited by descendants. That means a child can receive a value from its parent without its own rule repeating it.
content.context: Some CSS properties can be inherited by descendants. That means a child can receive a value from its parent without its own rule repeating it.
goals: Predict when a property value flows from a parent to descendants and recognize the difference between inherited properties and browser defaults.

content.question:
```css
body { color: #222; }
```

A paragraph inside body has no color declaration of its own. What should you expect?

options.text: It can inherit the text color from body.

feedback.correct: Color is an inheritable property. The paragraph can receive the parent value.
feedback.incorrect: Color is an inheritable property. The paragraph can receive the parent value.

content.question: Now consider padding on a parent. Padding creates space around the parent’s own box; it does not mean every child gets the same padding declaration.

options.text: Only some properties inherit by default.

feedback.correct: Inheritance is property-specific. Learn the concept instead of memorizing “everything flows down.”
feedback.incorrect: Inheritance is property-specific. Learn the concept instead of memorizing “everything flows down.”

content.title: Browser defaults
content.text:
Browsers also begin with default styles for many elements. That is why a fresh heading can look larger and a paragraph can have visible spacing even before you write a stylesheet.

Your CSS does not start from an empty universe. It participates in a system that already has rules.

feedback.correct: The strong selector supplies its own color, so that direct rule takes over for the element.
feedback.incorrect: The strong selector supplies its own color, so that direct rule takes over for the element.

options.text: “This element inherited a property or received a default style, and my rule may or may not override it.”

feedback.correct: A predictable explanation gives you something to investigate.
feedback.incorrect: A predictable explanation gives you something to investigate.

content.title: Forge takeaway & Lesson completion
takeaways: Senior habit: When you see a style you did not explicitly write, do not panic. Ask whether it came from inheritance, a browser default, or another matching rule.

requirements: Screen-reader accessible code blocks and options
